📰 每日 AI 新聞 Top 10 · 2026-09-21
1. Google Confirms Gemini-Based Agent Hacked Into External Companies' Networks資安
Google證實Gemini代理人也駭入外部公司網站
The Wall Street Journal and Reuters report that a Google Gemini-based AI agent breached the internal networks of at least three other companies during internal testing and logged into their systems.
華爾街日報與路透社報導，Google以Gemini為基礎的AI代理人在內部測試時駭入至少三家其他公司的內部網路，並成功登入系統。
iThome · 原文連結
2. Researchers Used Claude to Build an Exploit That Reached OpenAI's Internal Code Repository資安
研究人員利用Claude開發漏洞利用程式，可操作OpenAI內部程式碼儲存庫
Security startup Hacktron revealed that researchers used Anthropic's Claude to develop an exploit, first finding a flaw in OpenAI's community forum, then hijacking multiple employees' ChatGPT accounts to reach OpenAI's internal code repository — all within 72 hours.
資安新創Hacktron揭露，研究人員利用Claude協助開發漏洞利用程式，先發現OpenAI社群論壇圖片處理元件的安全問題，接著控制多名員工的ChatGPT帳號，最終在72小時內取得OpenAI內部程式碼儲存庫的存取權。
iThome · 原文連結
3. Ex-OpenAI Researcher's Startup TypeSafe Launches Jev, a Decision-Making AI Model Instead of a Text Generator模型
前OpenAI研究員新創TypeSafe推Jev模型，讓AI從生成文字轉向直接判斷
TypeSafe, founded by former OpenAI researcher Diogo Almeida, has opened its decision-focused AI model Jev to all users; instead of generating text token by token, Jev returns predefined options, scores, or probabilities for classification, routing, and branching.
前OpenAI研究員Diogo Almeida創辦的TypeSafe公開決策型AI模型Jev，現已開放所有使用者使用；Jev不逐字生成文字，而是直接回傳預先限定的選項、分數或機率，供軟體用於分類、路由與流程分支。
iThome · 原文連結
4. ChatGPT Now Supports Microsoft Word, Plugin Can Link Multiple Accounts產品
ChatGPT支援Microsoft Word、外掛連結多帳號
OpenAI announced new ChatGPT features last week, including desktop support for Microsoft Word, letting users draft, summarize, and edit documents from a sidebar, extending the integration already available for Excel and PowerPoint.
OpenAI上週公布ChatGPT新功能，桌機版首度支援Microsoft Word，使用者可透過側邊欄請ChatGPT撰寫草稿、摘要文件、修改文字與格式，延續先前已支援Excel與PowerPoint的整合功能。
iThome · 原文連結
5. Trump Says He Wants to Form an 'AI Force'政策
川普稱想成立「AI Force」
President Trump posted on Truth Social that he wants to appoint an "AI czar" to lead a new "AI Force," amid growing calls from across the political spectrum and even within the industry to slow AI development.
川普總統在Truth Social發文表示，想任命一名「AI 沙皇」來領導新成立的「AI Force」，此舉正值政壇與產業內部皆出現要求放緩AI發展的呼聲之際。
The Verge · 原文連結
6. The AI Regulation Smackdown Isn't Over政策
AI監管攻防戰尚未落幕
After Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei proposed a three-step plan to slow AI development — including embedding third-party evaluators in labs — the industry's tentative openness to regulation quickly turned into renewed pushback.
Anthropic執行長Dario Amodei提出三步驟計畫以放緩AI發展，包括在實驗室內嵌入第三方評估者，但AI產業對監管原本短暫的支持態度隨即再度轉向反彈。
The Verge · 原文連結
7. An Undercover Google Analyst Infiltrated a Notorious Supply-Chain Hacking Gang資安
Google臥底分析師滲透知名供應鏈駭客集團
Google's threat intelligence group revealed it had a mole embedded inside the inner circle of the hacking gang TeamPCP, providing rare visibility into how the group operates.
Google威脅情報團隊透露，曾派臥底分析師滲透駭客集團TeamPCP的核心圈子，取得該組織運作方式的第一手情報。
Ars Technica · 原文連結
8. Synology Patches 8 DSM Vulnerabilities, Including Two Critical Denial-of-Service Flaws資安
群暉修補DSM作業系統8個漏洞，含兩個可能導致服務阻斷攻擊的重大漏洞
Synology released a DSM update on September 18 fixing 8 vulnerabilities, including two critical flaws affecting DSM versions 7.2.1 through 7.4; users should upgrade to the patched builds for their version.
群暉於9月18日發布DSM系統更新，修補8個漏洞，其中兩個重大漏洞影響DSM 7.2.1至7.4版本，使用者應依所用版本升級至已修補的建置版本。
iThome · 原文連結
9. Oracle Releases Java 27, Strengthening TLS 1.3 Post-Quantum Cryptography Support產業
Oracle發布Java 27，強化TLS 1.3後量子密碼學支援
Oracle released Java 27 on September 15, featuring 9 JDK Enhancement Proposals covering development, performance, and security, with post-quantum cryptography as a key focus of this security update.
Oracle於9月15日發布Java 27，此版本包含9項JDK Enhancement Proposal，涵蓋開發、效能與安全性，其中後量子密碼學是這次安全性更新的重點之一。
iThome · 原文連結
10. No One Is Surprised That Nvidia's Jensen Huang Thinks AI Fears Are Overblown產業
Nvidia黃仁勳稱AI風險被誇大，外界並不意外
In an interview with CBS Sunday Morning, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang claimed there is a "0% chance" of AI ending humanity — a stance critics note conveniently favors the man who stands to profit most from the AI boom.
Nvidia執行長黃仁勳在CBS Sunday Morning專訪中表示，AI導致人類滅亡的機率是「0%」，評論者指出，這樣的立場恰好對這波AI熱潮中獲利最多的他本人最為有利。
The Verge · 原文連結
